title: Energy released calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes mass defect and converts to energy (ΔE ≈ 208.7 MeV) using given masses and conversion factor.

title: Number density derivation
description: Important: Correctly calculates number density N of U-235 in UO2 using density, molar mass, Avogadro's number, and natural abundance.

title: Heat production rate
description: Essential: Correctly applies Q = N σ φ E_f (with efficiency) to obtain Q ≈ 4.92e8 W/m³, including unit conversions.

title: Dimensional analysis function
description: Important: Correctly derives F(Q, a, λ) = Q a² / λ via dimensional analysis, leading to T_c - T_s = Q a²/(4λ).

title: Pin radius upper limit
description: Essential: Correctly solves a_u from temperature difference equation using given T_c - T_s limit and thermal conductivity.

title: CM frame speeds
description: Important: Correctly expresses neutron and moderator speeds in CM frame (v = A v_b/(A+1), V = v_b/(A+1)).

title: Energy ratio expression
description: Important: Correctly derives G(α,θ) = 1 - (1-α)(1-cosθ)/2 from collision kinematics.

title: Fractional energy loss
description: Important: Correctly computes maximum f_l = 1-α for D2O moderator (α = (19/21)², f_l ≈ 0.181).

title: Reactor geometry minimization
description: Important: Correctly relates reactor dimensions R and H via (2.405/R)² = 2(π/H)² for minimal leakage.

title: Fuel mass and channels
description: Essential: Correctly computes number of channels F_n from area and spacing, and total UO2 mass M from volume and density.

title: Unit or conversion error
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert units consistently (e.g., MeV to J, u to MeV/c²) or misplaces powers of ten.

title: Sign or formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect formula for mass defect, cross-section relation, or temperature difference expression.
